diagnosis: The prescription refill approval endpoint checks that the token has the 'prescriptions:refill' scope but loads the PrescriptionRefillRequest model globally without validating that the prescription originated from the clinician's practice or authorized dispensary. Pharmacy technicians from one clinic can approve refills for another clinic.
exploit_request:
POST /api/pharmacy/refills/5501/approve HTTP/1.1
Host: rx-network.healthprovider.com
Authorization: Bearer 73|pharmacisttoken3344
Content-Type: application/json
